notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Arc subclasses. The reprised Infinite Paths 8 is a Lightweight pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated D-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are on the low side by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/3176697588/infinite-paths-8 hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/3176697588 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is right and quite loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For single target damage, synergising with arc builds, in the first trait perk column, Trickle Charge refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target, or Supercharged Magazine refills 5% of the magazine every 1.5s while you're Amplified or, after you sprint when Amplified to gain Speed Booster this accelerates to 5% every 0.25s while the buff is active, overflowing the magazine to up to ×2 capacity. Alternatively, for your neutral game, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use. In the second column, for damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage. The Radiolaria Transposer origin trait is useful for clearing adds - three Minors or one Major or Boss enemy kill will result in a 3m AoE explosion on death, leaving a damaging pool of radiolaria for a few seconds. The damage is treated as weapon damage so inherits damage boosts. If you're interested, "Infinite Paths," refers to the Infinite Forest Vex simulation engine on Mercury, while the "8" references Lost Prophecy, Verse 8 - the specific algorithm or riddle that Brother Vance gave us to forge the weapon back in Curse of Osiris. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

The recoil is right and quite loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. Alternatively, for additional AoE damage, Dragonfly procs a 4.5m arc explosion on a crit kill - this counts as weapon damage so can inherit dmage buffs or, for your neutral game, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use. In the second column, for damage, Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 7s (8s when enhanced), after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Mercules904 notes (not great PvP): "High aim assist, reload speed, and decent stability all combine to make this gun pretty decent when used correctly, but sadly it resides firmly outside of the current competitive meta due to the high precision accuracy needed to achieve the optimal TtK, and comparative weakness to Rapid-Fire's within the same engagement ranges. I definitely recommend trying to get one, but mostly to put in the vault until such a time as the non-Aggressive pulses get some of their range back (or Lightweights get a damage buff)."
